SELECT t1.table_name, obj_description(pc.oid, 'pg_class') AS table_comment, (SELECT datcollate FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AS table_collation, 'PostgreSQL' AS engine, NULL::timestamp AS create_time, CASE WHEN t2.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_configured FROM information_schema.tables t1 JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.nspname = t1.table_schema JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.oid AND pc.relname = t1.table_name LEFT JOIN gen_config t2 ON t1.table_name = t2.table_name WHERE t1.table_schema = current_schema() AND t1.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
AND t1.table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryParams.keywords}, '%')
AND t1.table_name NOT IN
#{excludeTable}
ORDER BY t1.table_name

SELECT t.table_name, obj_description(pc.oid, 'pg_class') AS table_comment, (SELECT datcollate FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()) AS table_collation, 'PostgreSQL' AS engine, NULL::timestamp AS create_time FROM information_schema.tables t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.nspname = t.table_schema JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.oid AND pc.relname = t.table_name WHERE t.table_schema = current_schema() AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND t.table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT c.column_name, CASE c.data_type WHEN 'character varying' THEN 'varchar' WHEN 'character' THEN 'char' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'int' WHEN 'timestamp without time zone' THEN 'datetime' WHEN 'timestamp with time zone' THEN 'timestamp' WHEN 'double precision' THEN 'double' WHEN 'real' THEN 'float' WHEN 'numeric' THEN 'decimal' WHEN 'bytea' THEN 'blob' ELSE c.data_type END AS data_type, col_description(pc.oid, pa.attnum) AS column_comment, CASE WHEN pi.indisprimary THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_primary_key, c.is_nullable, c.character_maximum_length, c.character_set_name, c.collation_name FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.nspname = c.table_schema JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.oid AND pc.relname = c.table_name JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute pa ON pa.attrelid = pc.oid AND pa.attname = c.column_name LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index pi ON pi.indrelid = pc.oid AND pi.indisprimary AND pa.attnum = ANY(pi.indkey) WHERE c.table_schema = current_schema() AND c.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.ordinal_position ASC
